positions.title: Staff Frontend Engineer
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Remote

positions.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed, built, and led a team through creating React and TypeScript applications
• Architected and lead multiple projects, crafting complex PRDs and ensured on time delivery
• Reimplemented custom form rendering service and decreased keystroke latency by 15x
• Addressed customer pain points via frequent communication, leading to high customer satisfaction
• Collaborated with product teams to successfully implement customer-driven solutions
• Advised on best practices across teams to decrease start times and increase developer productivity
• Mentored engineers across the company, ensuring high code quality and consistent personal growth

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
• Built and maintained insurance software using React and TypeScript
• Responsible for leading a team locally and abroad in changes to website accessed by 300k users per year
• Followed specific design guidelines and rearchitected the 500+ pages of our customer facing website
• Rebuilt an internal CMS to use state of the art components that meet the highest levels of accessibility
• Provided feedback to designers and product owners on scooping, time to market, and best practices
• Created a large suite of components using Typescript and React, maintaining 100% code coverage
• Worked on a fast-paced team that released multiple times per day (over 700 releases last year)
• Built in a stack using Node.js, React, Postgres, hosted on AWS, deployed by Kubernetes through Docker
• Assisted across the stack in Node.JS environment updating APIs and integrating existing ones
• Collaborated with a small team of engineers in pull requests, prioritization, and refactoring needs

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a website for tracking and managing bankruptcy cases in React, TypeScript, and C#
• Refactored front-end architecture into modular packages, reducing time to develop new pages
• Built component library utilizing Storybook UI, opening access to modular React components
• Front-end lead and gatekeeper, mentored teammates on all front-end architecture related needs
• Implemented mandatory unit and integration testing using Jest and Enzyme for all pull requests
• Worked full-stack creating web APIs, maintaining large databases, and adding new business logic

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Full stack engineer for the Patient Portal web team using Java, JavaScript, Python, and Django
• Worked in Python and Django to create blood pressure monitors for Cerner's Patient Portal
• Built scalable and modular components for a web app used by 50,000+ people per month in mid-Missouri
• Utilized test-driven development practices, agile methodology, code reviews, and iterative release cycles

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Redesigned a Patient facing website using JavaScript, JQuery, and responsive web design
• Reworked Patient/Physician messaging platform UX to create a robust user experience
• Refactored the Patient facing front-end code, reducing JavaScript and CSS by more than half
• Implemented and maintained software suite with a team of six engineers using Java and Python
• Utilized test-driven development practices, agile methodology, code reviews, and iterative release cycles

honors.description: Awarded trip to Twitter to network with companies in the software engineering field in September of 2015. Out for Undergraduate's "goal is to educate, inspire, and advance LGBT undergraduates who are interested in careers at the world’s leading technology companies."
